parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT * FROM v_fair_prices ORDER BY brand, reference) t)                  AS fair_prices,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT * FROM v_country_prices ORDER BY reference, avg_new_equiv_usd) t)   AS country_prices,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT * FROM v_competitor_moves ORDER BY seller, reference) t)            AS competitor_moves,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT * FROM v_retail_vs_market ORDER BY premium_pct DESC) t)             AS retail_vs_market,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT * FROM v_seasonality ORDER BY reference, month) t)                  AS seasonality,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (
      SELECT d.discount_pct, d.suspicious, d.price_usd, d.fair_usd, mp.reference, mp.title, mp.country, mp.url
      FROM deals d JOIN market_prices mp ON mp.id = d.market_price_id
      WHERE d.created_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
      ORDER BY d.discount_pct DESC LIMIT 10) t)                                                        AS top_deals,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (
      SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS watches, ROUND(SUM(ask_usd)) AS stock_value_usd,
             ROUND(SUM(ask_usd - cost_usd)) AS expected_margin_usd
      FROM watches GROUP BY status) t)                                                                AS inventory,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (
      SELECT w.brand, w.reference, w.ask_usd, fair_price(w.reference, w.condition, w.box_papers) AS fair_now_usd,
             (CURRENT_DATE - w.created_at::DATE) AS days_in_stock
      FROM watches w WHERE w.status = 'in_stock' ORDER BY days_in_stock DESC LIMIT 20) t)              AS stock_vs_market,
  (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'owner_email') AS owner_email,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'business_name') AS business_name;

parameters.content:
## Weekly market report
Every Monday: competitor price moves, cheapest countries, models above retail, seasonality, best deals, and your stock vs market - with a short analysis and action list from Claude.

Add competitors in the `competitors` table (seller names as they appear in `market_prices`).
